tldr: 台股盤中震盪近749點，尾盤台積電拉抬終場收44,850.81點、僅漲25點，外資連二買、三大法人買超164.89億元。
投信連21日買超約2,398億元、加碼記憶體與ABF載板，台積電法說後外資調高目標價最高至4,200元。
金管會核准土銀高資產業務、修正虛擬資產防詐規定，高資產財管AUM突破2.26兆、國銀今年拚3兆。
美股7月23日重挫（標普-1.21%、那斯達克-2.15%、道瓊-0.97%），Alphabet、特斯拉因AI支出疑慮分別跌約7%、14%；行政院通過婚育家庭房屋稅、地價稅優惠修法。
布蘭特原油因中東緊張與紅海油輪遇襲首度突破100美元，歐洲央行維持存款利率2.25%以評估伊朗戰事衝擊。

items.title_zh: 台積電尾盤拉抬 台股震盪收漲25點
items.title_en: TAIEX ekes out 25-point gain as TSMC tail-end mark-up rescues a whipsaw session
items.summary_zh: 台股7月23日盤中劇烈震盪逾749點，一度翻黑下跌逾400點，追價買盤轉趨保守；尾盤台積電作價收高5元，帶動加權指數終場收在44,850.81點、小漲25.03點。這根長下影線顯示，在前波反彈後市場追高意願降溫，權值股成為撐盤主力，而非全面性買氣，後續量能與台積電法說效應能否延續為觀盤重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index swung through a roughly 749-point intraday range on July 23, at one point falling more than 400 points into the red, before a late mark-up in TSMC — which closed up NT$5 — lifted the TAIEX to finish at 44,850.81, up just 25.03 points. The wild swing showed buyers turning cautious about chasing prices after the recent rebound, with index heavyweights doing the heavy lifting into the close rather than broad-based participation.

items.title_zh: 外資連二買 三大法人買超164.89億元
items.title_en: Foreign investors extend buying to a second session; institutions net-buy NT$16.5bn
items.summary_zh: 台股7月23日外資買超69.58億元、連續第二個交易日站在買方，三大法人合計買超164.89億元，其中投信買超53.37億元、自營商買超41.94億元。外資買超前三大為緯創、中鋼、台塑，橫跨AI硬體與傳產權值股，顯示資金布局趨於全面，而非單押記憶體或AI概念，反映買盤基礎逐步擴大，惟能否延續仍需觀察後市成交量與國際盤面。
items.summary_en: Overseas investors bought a net NT$6.958 billion of Taiwan shares on July 23, staying on the buy side for a second straight session, while the three major institutional groups together net-bought NT$16.489 billion, with investment trusts adding NT$5.337 billion and dealers NT$4.194 billion. Foreigners' top buys were led by Wistron, China Steel and Formosa Plastics, a spread across AI hardware and traditional heavyweights that suggests the inflows are broadening rather than concentrated purely in memory or AI names.

items.title_zh: 投信連21日買超 加碼記憶體雙強與ABF載板三雄
items.title_en: Investment trusts extend buying to 21 straight sessions, loading up on memory and ABF names
items.summary_zh: 國內投信已連續21個交易日買超台股，累計買超約2,398.75億元，加碼標的集中在記憶體雙強、ABF載板三雄，並鎖定一檔傳產股。投信持續加碼，反映法人對AI帶動的記憶體漲價與先進封裝上升循環仍具信心，也為台股提供內資撐盤力道；在外資進出反覆之際，本土資金成為盤面重要支撐，惟後續須留意獲利了結賣壓與族群輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: Domestic investment trusts have net-bought Taiwan shares for 21 consecutive trading days, accumulating some NT$239.9 billion, and are concentrating fresh money on the two big memory makers and the trio of ABF substrate suppliers, alongside a favored traditional-industry stock. The persistent trust buying reflects conviction that the AI-driven up-cycle in memory pricing and advanced packaging still has room to run, and provides a domestic buffer supporting the market even as foreign flows stay choppy.

items.title_zh: 台積電法說後外資調高目標價 最高上看4,200元
items.title_en: Foreign brokers lift TSMC targets after upbeat call, some to NT$4,200
items.summary_zh: 台積電法說會端出「財報優於預期、展望同步上修」，上調全年營收年增率至約40%、調高2026年資本支出，並加碼美國投資，帶動多家外資調升目標價，最高喊到4,200元。外資指出，AI需求正由GPU加速器擴散至CPU、客製化ASIC與網通晶片，動能基礎持續擴大，可望撐起未來數年營收與獲利，並鞏固台灣先進製程供應鏈的長線成長，惟海外設廠稀釋毛利仍須觀察。
items.summary_en: Following TSMC's earnings call, several foreign houses raised their price targets, with the highest reaching NT$4,200, after the chipmaker again delivered better-than-expected results and lifted its guidance — raising full-year revenue growth guidance toward 40%, boosting 2026 capex and adding to its US investment plan. Brokers argue AI demand is broadening from GPU accelerators into CPUs, custom ASICs and networking chips, a widening base they see driving revenue and earnings for years and reinforcing the whole Taiwan advanced-node supply chain.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准土銀辦高資產業務、許可電支跨境小額匯兌
items.title_en: FSC clears Land Bank for high-net-worth business and licenses e-payment cross-border remittance
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意臺灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務，並許可歐付寶電子支付經營國外小額匯兌，含外籍移工國外小額匯兌業務。開放更多銀行承作高資產業務，將加深快速成長的高資產客群競爭；而核准電支跨境匯兌，為外籍移工等族群提供合法、低成本的匯款管道，反映主管機關推動普惠金融基礎建設、擴大合規金流覆蓋面的政策方向。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission approved Taiwan's Land Bank to offer financial products and services tailored to high-asset clients, and separately licensed an electronic-payment operator to run small-value cross-border remittance, including services for migrant workers. Widening the roster of banks permitted to serve wealthy customers deepens competition in the fast-growing high-asset segment, while the remittance approval extends regulated, lower-cost channels to underserved groups and reflects the regulator's push to broaden inclusive financial infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正防制虛擬資產詐欺犯罪相關規定
items.title_en: FSC tightens anti-fraud rules covering virtual-asset service providers
items.summary_zh: 金管會修正「金融機構及提供虛擬資產服務之事業或人員防制詐欺犯罪危害」相關規定，為打詐政策一環。將防詐義務明確涵蓋虛擬資產服務業者，將提高加密貨幣管道的法遵與監控要求，力圖堵住詐騙集團利用銀行與數位資產平台間落差的漏洞，也顯示主管機關對虛擬資產業的監理持續趨嚴，業者須強化KYC與可疑金流通報機制以因應。
items.summary_en: The regulator amended its rules on preventing fraud-related harms by financial institutions and virtual-asset service providers, part of a broader crackdown as scam losses remain a policy priority. Extending anti-fraud obligations explicitly to VASPs raises compliance and monitoring requirements across the crypto channel, aiming to close gaps that fraudsters exploit between banks and digital-asset platforms and signaling continued regulatory tightening on Taiwan's virtual-asset industry.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管AUM突破2.26兆 國銀今年拚3兆
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-asset banking AUM tops NT$2.26tn as banks chase the NT$3tn mark
items.summary_zh: 已核准的21家銀行高資產業務全數開辦，截至1月底客戶數達21,543人，管理資產規模突破2兆元、達2兆2,589億元，客戶數與規模年增率分別約76.97%、56.37%。在國銀積極搶客下，業界今年目標挑戰3兆元大關。此一成長凸顯私人銀行式服務與金融資產擔保融資，已成國銀重要獲利引擎，也帶動「資產池」彈性融資等新機制普及，深化對高資產客群的整合服務。
items.summary_en: All 21 banks approved for high-asset wealth management are now up and running, with client numbers reaching 21,543 and assets under management breaking above NT$2 trillion to NT$2.2589 trillion as of end-January — annual growth of about 76.97% in clients and 56.37% in AUM. With banks aggressively courting the wealthy, the industry is targeting NT$3 trillion this year, underscoring how private-banking-style services and asset-backed lending have become a key growth engine for domestic banks.

items.title_zh: 亞資高峰論壇：銀行看好私募與家辦 籲擴大另類資產
items.title_en: Asia wealth forum: banks bet on private markets and family offices, urge more alternatives
items.summary_zh: 2026亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業表示看好私募市場與家族辦公室業務，呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財富管理服務。與會者指出，相較國際私人銀行，台灣仍缺乏私募股權、私募債權、避險基金及家族辦公室專屬投資等另類商品。此一方向點出高資產需求的走向，也促使本土業者加速建置另類資產與跨境服務能力，以留住高資產客戶、避免資金外流至海外私銀平台。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Asian asset-management summit, bankers said they are bullish on private markets and family-office services, calling for wider allocation to alternative assets and deeper cross-border wealth-management offerings. Speakers noted Taiwan still lacks alternative products — private equity, private credit, hedge funds and family-office-dedicated vehicles — relative to international private banks. The push points to where high-net-worth demand is heading, and pressures local players to build out alternatives and cross-border capabilities to retain wealthy clients.

items.title_zh: 行政院通過婚育家庭房屋稅、地價稅優惠修法
items.title_en: Cabinet approves tax breaks for newlywed and child-rearing households
items.summary_zh: 行政院院會通過《房屋稅條例》與《土地稅法》修正草案，授權地方政府對新婚2年內或育有未成年子女的家庭，就其全國持有的單一自住房屋及坐落土地，於自用住宅優惠稅率（房屋稅1%、地價稅2‰）之外再給予減免。此舉意在減輕年輕家庭購屋與持有成本、呼應婚育政策，惟實際減免幅度仍取決於各地方政府後續訂定的自治法規與適用條件，民眾可留意所在縣市的實施辦法。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Executive Yuan cleared draft amendments to the House Tax Act and Land Tax Act that would authorize local governments to grant additional house-tax and land-tax relief to newlywed couples (within two years) or families raising minor children, on top of the owner-occupier preferential rates (house tax 1%; land tax 0.2%) for a single self-use home nationwide. The move aims to ease housing-cost burdens for young families and support marriage-and-childbirth policy, though the actual relief depends on each locality's implementation.

items.title_zh: 綜所稅首批退稅7月31日發放 新增無障礙報稅工具
items.title_en: First-batch income-tax refunds set for July 31; new accessibility filing tools rolled out
items.summary_zh: 於5月上旬前以書面回復稅額試算、或6月1日前完成網路申報者列入首批退稅，預計2026年7月31日發放。財政部同步推出9項便民措施：新增「網頁無障礙專用版報稅系統」，電腦、手機皆可搭配螢幕報讀軟體使用；並開放逾期30天內的國稅查（核）定案件，可用信用卡、晶片金融卡或活期存款帳戶線上繳稅，降低民眾報稅與繳稅的時間與費用成本。
items.summary_en: Taxpayers who returned their pre-calculated tax statements in early May or completed online filing before June 1 fall into the first refund batch, with payments scheduled for July 31. Alongside, the tax authority launched an accessibility-friendly web filing system usable on PC or phone with screen readers, and opened online payment by credit card, chip card or deposit account for national-tax assessment cases within 30 days overdue — part of nine convenience measures aimed at making filing cheaper and easier.
items.source_name: 聯合新聞網 稅務專題

items.title_zh: 中經院上修台灣成長預測 CPI上修逼近2%警戒線
items.title_en: CIER lifts Taiwan growth outlook on strong tech exports, nudges CPI toward the 2% line
items.summary_zh: 中華經濟研究院於最新一季預測上修2026年台灣GDP，呈「前高後穩」走勢，上半年強勁、下半年溫和走穩，並將2026年CPI年增率上修至約1.95%，逼近2%通膨警戒線。研究人員指出，美國經貿與關稅政策為出口最大下行風險，地緣政治衝突與AI循環的不確定性亦壓抑展望。整體而言，內需與科技出口撐盤，但外部變數升高，政策須在成長與物價間審慎拿捏。
items.summary_en: The Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research raised its 2026 Taiwan GDP forecast in its latest quarterly update, describing a "strong-first, steady-later" path with a robust first half moderating through the second half, and lifted its 2026 CPI forecast to about 1.95% — close to the 2% inflation warning line. Researchers flagged US trade and tariff policy as the biggest downside risk to exports, alongside geopolitical conflict and AI-cycle uncertainty weighing on the outlook.

items.title_en: June CPI hits 2.60%, a 17-month high, as oil and vegetable prices bite
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月消費者物價指數年增2.60%，為近17個月新高，且連續2個月突破2%通膨警戒線，主因油價與菜價上漲。央行6月已將2026年CPI預測上修至1.91%、核心CPI 1.90%，並將「美國經貿政策變化」列為須持續關注的風險。央行指出，國際油價、進口物價與服務類通膨仍有上行壓力，惟整體通膨仍屬溫和，後續油價走勢與關稅談判進展將是通膨與利率政策的關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June consumer price index rose 2.60% year-on-year, the highest in about 17 months and a second straight month above the 2% inflation warning line, driven by higher oil and vegetable prices. The central bank, which in June nudged its 2026 CPI forecast up to 1.91% (core 1.90%), has flagged US trade policy as a risk it must keep monitoring, warning that international oil, import prices and services inflation still carry upside pressure even as the overall picture stays moderate.

items.title_zh: 美股7月23日重挫 AI支出疑慮衝擊科技巨頭
items.title_en: US stocks sell off on July 23 as AI-spending jitters hit megacaps
items.summary_zh: 美股7月23日收黑，標普500下跌1.21%收7,408.30點、那斯達克跌2.15%收25,137.69點、道瓊跌0.97%收51,711.65點。Alphabet與特斯拉財報後分別重挫約7%與14%領跌，投資人聚焦AI資本支出飆升、質疑龐大投資能否轉化為獲利，加上油價急漲加深避險氣氛。科技權值股回檔為主要拖累，市場對AI獲利兌現的耐心受到考驗，短線波動恐加大。
items.summary_en: Wall Street fell sharply on July 23, with the S&P 500 down 1.21% to 7,408.30, the Nasdaq Composite off 2.15% to 25,137.69 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average losing 0.97% to 51,711.65. The slide was led by roughly 7% and 14% drops in Alphabet and Tesla after their results, as investors focused on soaring AI capital spending and questioned whether that investment is translating into profit, while surging oil prices added to the risk-off tone.

items.title_zh: 布蘭特原油站上百美元 中東緊張升溫
items.title_en: Brent tops US$100 for first time since May as Middle East tensions escalate
items.summary_zh: 國際油價7月23日飆漲，布蘭特原油漲約7%至100.69美元、為5月26日以來首度收在100美元之上，美國西德州中級原油漲約6%至92.19美元，起因於紅海油輪傳遭攻擊、川普揚言對伊朗發動「大規模攻擊」。本月以來油價因中東戰事升溫已漲逾30%，荷莫茲與曼德海峽周邊風險升高。油價急漲將推升全球通膨與進口成本，對能源進口國的物價與央行政策形成新壓力。
items.summary_en: Oil prices surged on July 23, with Brent crude up about 7% to $100.69 — its first close above $100 since May 26 — and US WTI up roughly 6% to $92.19, after reports of attacks on tankers in the Red Sea and President Trump threatening a "massive attack" on Iran. Crude has jumped more than 30% this month as fighting escalates around the Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb straits, adding fresh upside risk to global inflation and import costs.

items.title_zh: Alphabet上修2026資本支出至1,950-2,050億美元、股價下挫（2026-07-22）
items.title_en: Alphabet lifts 2026 capex guidance to US$195-205bn, stock sinks (2026-07-22)
items.summary_zh: Alphabet第二季營收優於預期，但盤後股價下跌逾4%，因其將全年資本支出財測由原先1,800-1,900億美元上調至1,950-2,050億美元，並預警2027年支出將更高。市場焦點落在持續擴大的AI基礎建設投資，而非優於預期的獲利，反映投資人對AI花費能否轉為報酬的疑慮升高。
items.summary_en: Alphabet beat Q2 revenue estimates but its shares fell more than 4% after hours after it raised full-year capital-expenditure guidance to $195-205 billion, up from a prior $180-190 billion, and warned of even higher spending in 2027. Investors focused on the widening AI infrastructure bill rather than the earnings beat.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉與Alphabet財報後市值蒸發數千億美元（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: Tesla and Alphabet shed hundreds of billions in value post-earnings (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉與Alphabet財報後合計市值蒸發數千億美元，特斯拉重挫逾14%，因其繳出逾兩年來首見的負自由現金流，缺口達11億美元（去年同期為正1.46億美元）。兩家公司第二季自由現金流同步轉負，使市場對AI時代龐大資本支出的審視加劇，也牽動整體科技股評價與資金情緒。
items.summary_en: Tesla and Alphabet lost hundreds of billions in combined market value after their reports, with Tesla down more than 14% after posting its first negative free cash flow in over two years — a $1.1 billion deficit versus $146 million a year earlier. Both companies reported negative Q2 free cash flow, intensifying scrutiny of AI-era spending.

items.title_zh: 油價續漲：川普威脅伊朗、紅海油輪遇襲（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: Oil jumps as Trump threatens Iran and tankers hit in Red Sea (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 西德州與布蘭特原油連續第五個交易日走高，因葉門青年運動稱以無人機與飛彈攻擊兩艘沙烏地油輪，川普則揚言對伊朗發動「大規模攻擊」。布蘭特原油自5月下旬以來首度突破每桶100美元，市場緊盯荷莫茲與曼德海峽等關鍵航道的中斷風險，地緣情勢牽動能源與全球通膨預期。
items.summary_en: WTI and Brent climbed for a fifth straight session after Houthi forces said they targeted two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea and President Trump threatened a "massive attack" on Iran. Brent crossed $100 a barrel for the first time since late May, with markets watching risks around the Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb chokepoints.

items.title_zh: 歐洲央行按兵不動 靜待伊朗戰事影響（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: ECB holds rates as Lagarde awaits Iran-war fallout (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 歐洲央行7月23日維持三大關鍵利率不變，存款利率續留2.25%，在上月意外升息後暫停，以評估中東衝突再起對通膨的影響。歐洲央行表示，能源價格雖劇烈波動，仍接近基準預測、但遠高於衝突前水準，並承諾密切關注此衝擊的強度與持續時間。此一觀望立場顯示，地緣風險已成主要央行貨幣政策路徑的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: The European Central Bank kept its three key rates unchanged on July 23, leaving the deposit rate at 2.25%, pausing after last month's surprise hike to assess the inflationary impact of renewed Middle East conflict. The ECB said energy prices, while volatile, sat close to baseline projections but well above pre-conflict levels, and pledged to monitor the shock's intensity and duration.
